AM 的“功率利用率”指信息功率占总功率的比例，100% 调制时也只有 1/3，: AM's "power efficiency" is the share of total power that carries information — only 1/3 even at 100% modulation, so for the same information power SSB is markedly more economical (often quoted as about 4× / 6 dB better).
FM 解调时较强信号压制较弱信号，强弱幅度比约 2:1（数 dB）以上时强台完全: In FM demodulation the stronger signal suppresses the weaker one; above about a 2:1 amplitude ratio (a few dB) the stronger station wins outright — both the cause of co-channel "capture" and the reason FM co-channel reuse is limited.
上下边带各占一段等于音频最高频率 fm 的频谱，总带宽为音频带宽的两倍（话音约: Each sideband occupies a band equal to the highest audio frequency fm, so the total bandwidth is twice the audio bandwidth (about 6 kHz for voice).
二极管 + RC 低通，取出已调波包络即恢复音频，简单但要求载波足够强。: A diode plus an RC low-pass recovers the audio by taking the modulated envelope; simple, but requires the carrier to be strong enough.
信息改变载波的深度：AM 用调幅系数 m，FM 用 β = Δf / fm（峰值: How deeply the information changes the carrier: AM uses the modulation factor m, FM uses β = Δf / fm (peak deviation ÷ audio frequency).
先抑制载波（DSB），再抑制一个边带（SSB）。全部功率集中在单个边带，功率与带: Suppress the carrier first (DSB), then one sideband (SSB). All power concentrates in a single sideband, giving the highest power and bandwidth efficiency — the mainstay of HF voice.
原始的音频或数据信号，频谱从接近直流开始，必须搬移到射频才能有效辐射。: The original audio or data signal, with a spectrum starting near DC; it must be shifted to RF to radiate effectively.
发射端预加重提升音频高频（时间常数 75 µs 美制 / 50 µs 欧制），接: The transmitter pre-emphasises high audio frequencies (time constant 75 µs US / 50 µs European) and the receiver de-emphasises by the same amount, improving high-frequency SNR.
只传一个边带，带宽等于音频带宽（话音约 2.4–2.7 kHz）。: Only one sideband is transmitted; bandwidth equals the audio bandwidth (about 2.4–2.7 kHz for voice).
同一种信息（话音）用不同调制方式，占用带宽与所需功率差别很大：SSB 最省带宽与: The same information (voice) needs very different bandwidth and power depending on the modulation: SSB is the most economical in bandwidth and power, FM uses the most bandwidth but resists noise best.
宽带 FM 占用带宽约为峰值频偏 Δf 与最高音频 fm 之和的两倍。: Wideband FM occupies roughly twice the sum of the peak deviation Δf and the highest audio frequency fm.
宽带 FM 靠增大调制指数换取输出信噪比改善（大 β 时改善量约正比于 β²，即: Wideband FM trades a larger modulation index for output SNR improvement (with large β the improvement is roughly proportional to β², i.e. about 3β²); the price is wider occupied bandwidth.
已调波振幅的轮廓；AM 的包络直接反映音频，因此可用包络检波恢复。: The outline of the modulated wave's amplitude; in AM the envelope directly follows the audio, so envelope detection can recover it.
幅度恒定、频率随音频变化；抗幅度噪声强、有捕获效应，但占用带宽大（见 Carso: Constant amplitude with frequency varying per the audio; strongly resistant to amplitude noise and shows a capture effect, but occupies wide bandwidth (see Carson's rule).
把频率变化转换为幅度变化（Foster-Seeley / 比例鉴频器），或用 P: Converts frequency variation into amplitude variation (Foster-Seeley / ratio detector), or demodulates with a phase-locked loop.
未调制的射频正弦波；频率高、便于天线高效辐射，本身不携带信息。: An unmodulated RF sine wave; high in frequency so an antenna radiates it efficiently, but it carries no information itself.
本地恢复的载波与接收信号相乘再低通；SSB 常用拍频振荡器（BFO）注入，因此需: The locally recovered carrier is multiplied with the received signal and low-passed; SSB usually injects a beat-frequency oscillator (BFO), so a stable BFO is needed.
用「带宽」与「信噪比」两个维度比较调制方式，就能理解为何 HF 远距离用 SSB: Comparing modulation types along the two axes of "bandwidth" and "SNR" explains why long-distance HF uses SSB while local VHF uses FM.
用与发端同频同相的本地载波相乘，配合载波恢复环（如 Costas 环）。: Multiplies by a local carrier of the same frequency and phase as the transmitter, with a carrier-recovery loop (e.g. a Costas loop).
用信息信号（基带）去改变载波的幅度、频率或相位，使信息便于天线辐射与传输。: Using the information signal (baseband) to vary the amplitude, frequency or phase of the carrier so the information can be radiated and transmitted by an antenna.
相位随音频变化；许多标称“调频”的电台实际采用相位调制（发射标识 G3E）。: Phase varies with the audio; many radios labelled "FM" actually use phase modulation (emission designator G3E).
调制在载波频率上下两侧新生出的频率分量，真正承载信息。: Frequency components newly created by modulation above and below the carrier frequency; they actually carry the information.
调制指数决定占用带宽：AM 过调制会产生谐波与邻道干扰，FM 频偏过大同样会超出: The modulation index sets the occupied bandwidth: over-modulation in AM creates harmonics and adjacent-channel interference, and excessive FM deviation likewise exceeds the allowed bandwidth.
调制指数小于 1，带宽接近 2 · fm，常用于对讲与低速数据。: Modulation index below 1, bandwidth close to 2 · fm; common for two-way radio and low-speed data.
载波 + 上下两个边带。100% 调制时载波占 2/3 功率、每边带各占 1/6: Carrier plus upper and lower sidebands. At 100% modulation the carrier takes 2/3 of the power and each sideband 1/6, so only 1/3 of the power carries information: inefficient, but detection is simple.
输入信噪比低于约 10 dB 的门限时，鉴频器输出信噪比急剧恶化（出现脉冲噪声“: Below an input SNR threshold of about 10 dB the discriminator's output SNR degrades sharply (impulse "crackling" noise appears), so weak signals are better served by narrowband or by switching to SSB.
